composition.description: Formula and pinned input versions to validate without saving.

expression.description: Bounded arithmetic or Boolean expression. Use number(boolean), category membership, and conditional expressions for conversions.

inputs.description: Named, version-pinned input scorers for the same item. Nested composites are not supported.

alias.description: Input name used in the formula. Start with a lowercase letter; use letters, digits, and underscores.

scorer_version_id.description: Exact immutable version of an ordinary input scorer.

kind.description:
Expected formula output kind.

* `categorical` - categorical
* `numeric` - numeric
* `boolean` - boolean
